{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
filtered_df = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = filtered_df[filtered_df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders in loyal, completed group: {len(qa_orders)}')"}
